verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately extract the 33 wells across the 8 specified Illinois water systems and correctly identify the exact same 7 qualifying wells in Farmer City, Weldon, and Waynesville. However, Deliverable A is significantly more thorough and demonstrates superior project management judgment. Deliverable A actually read the narrative sections of the IEPA factsheets in addition to scraping the well tables, catching critical operational discrepancies (e.g., noting that "Farmer City's narrative lists Wells #2, #9, #10 and #11 as the supply wells, but the well table shows Well 2 as ABANDONED and Well 7 (WL47646) as active"). Furthermore, Deliverable A incorporates relevant green hydrogen context from DOE records regarding water demand per kg of H2, includes the IEPA facility ID numbers directly in the Water System column, and adds helpful Priority Rank and PM Comment columns on the second tab of the workbook. Deliverable B is a solid, concise response with a nice summary table in the email, but it misses the deeper factsheet insights that make Deliverable A stand out as senior-level work.
